recovery_controls: retry may claim only a retryable_failed WorkUnit and preserves immutable Attempt history
retry budget or maximum Attempt exhaustion becomes terminal and can be dead-lettered
poison failure is never retried and can be dead-lettered
resume and fork require an exact artifact version ref produced by the declared parent Attempt
replay plan is read-only, digest-bound and contains no external calls
fork creates a new WorkUnit with immutable lineage and never changes the source WorkUnit
